stem_book: Find the acceleration of all blocks just after the string is cut. A 3 kg block hangs from the ceiling by a string; a 1 kg block hangs from the 3 kg block by a second string (the one that is cut); a 2 kg block hangs from the 1 kg block by a light spring. The system is initially at rest. (g = 10 m/s²)
correct_answer: a(3 kg) = 0, a(1 kg) = 3g (30 m/s²) downward, a(2 kg) = 0
reason: Multi-part: asks three separate accelerations (0, 3g, 0) — usable only if re-asked for the 1 kg block alone (30 m/s², integer).
work: Spring force = 2g = 20 N unchanged: 1 kg → (10 + 20)/1 = 30 m/s² down; 2 kg → 20 − 20 = 0; 3 kg still held by ceiling string → 0
